title: Fall for Niagara Tour
includes: Pickup and drop-off from a central location
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended for people with mobility issues. (Bus stairs, long periods walking)
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our Fall for Niagara day tour from Toronto offers a relaxed and scenic way to experience the natural wonder of Niagara Falls. Enjoy round-trip transportation from Toronto and plenty of time to explore the breathtaking views of the famous Horseshoe Falls.

Along the way, travel the beautiful Niagara Parkway, often called one of the prettiest drives in Canada, with photo stops at several historic and scenic landmarks including Table Rock Welcome Centre, the powerful Whirlpool Rapids, the massive hydro-electric dams of the Niagara Parks Power Station, and the famous Floral Clock.

Throughout the journey, your licensed tour guide provides engaging stories, history, and fascinating facts about Niagara Falls and the surrounding region. Our goal is for every guest to enjoy a memorable Niagara Falls experience and leave with photos and memories that will last a lifetime.
